event_name: Document 30 Date 04 August 2019 Time 12:24 2019 HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX 1 - 4 August 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 28), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: A 4th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE), 4th Turbocharger (TC), 4th Motor Generator Unit – Heat (MGU-H), 3rd Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K), 3rd Energy Store (ES) and 3rd Control Electronics (CE) have been used.
